name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel 45" Undermount Workstation Sink with Custom-Fit Accessories
shortDescription: Elevate your kitchen with the 45" MultiSINK Workstation where sculpted design meets unmatched versatility. This undermount centerpiece features a 3-level layout and a 10" deep basin, crafted for seamless prep, rinse, and cleanup. The auxiliary sliding sink adds flexibility for quick tasks, while the stainless steel colander handles rinsing and straining with ease. A double-sided bamboo cutting board offers juice control whether used over the sink or on the counter. Four heavy-duty roll-up grids provide extra space for drying, staging, or creative prep. cUPC certification ensure lasting quality and universal fit. With its refined corners, premium finish, and integrated ledge system, MultiSINK is more than a workstation it’s the heart of a beautifully efficient kitchen.
